entities.summary: Josiane Kartheiser is a Luxembourgish journalist, novelist, and writer. She writes mainly in German but also in Luxembourgish. Kartheiser received the Anne Beffort Prize from the City of Luxembourg for her contribution over 25 years to Luxembourg's literary scene at a time when the sector was dominated by men.
